scripts.test:integration:services:up: docker network create crawlee-it 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --rm --name crawlee-it-browserless --network crawlee-it -p 3000:3000 -e CONCURRENT=4 ghcr.io/browserless/chromium && docker run -d --rm --name crawlee-it-httpbin --network crawlee-it --network-alias httpbin -p 8080:80 kennethreitz/httpbin
scripts.test:integration:services:down: docker stop crawlee-it-browserless crawlee-it-httpbin; docker network rm crawlee-it 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.api:extract: pnpm build && pnpm dlx github:apify/api-extractor-report --exclude=@crawlee/cli,@crawlee/templates --extract-command='pnpm api:extract'
